# natdal 0.2.0

inkshot records your screen, on Windows and on macOS 15 and later — plus notifications you can find
again and updates that update everything.

## What's new

- **inkshot screen recording** — Alt+Shift+S (or **R** while capturing) picks what to record the way
  a capture does: drag an area, **Space** for a window (followed as it moves), **F** for the whole
  display. The recording bar sets where the file goes, the quality and the sound; **Enter** on Record
  or **F9** starts, **F10** stops and saves, **Esc** throws it away. While it records only a red frame
  and a clock show — never in the file — and F10 and Esc are taken from other apps only then.
- **Small files by default** — the "small file" quality is made for bug reports and chats: at most
  1280 × 720, 15 frames a second written only when the screen changes, mono sound — about 1 MB a
  minute. Standard (the screen's own size, 30 fps) and high quality (60 fps) are a click away.
- **Sound**: none, what the computer plays (inkshot's own sounds left out), the microphone, or both.
- MP4 (H.264 + AAC) from the system's own encoders: Windows.Graphics.Capture and Media Foundation on
  Windows, ScreenCaptureKit on macOS 15 and later. No extra downloads.
- **Agents**: `start_recording` (needs agent write access, and a time limit), `stop_recording`,
  `cancel_recording`, `get_recording_status` in `inkshot mcp`, and `inkshot record …` on the command
  line. When an agent records, you see the frame and a notification.
- **macOS: recording runs in natdal's screen helper**, which natdal keeps as an app of its own
  outside natdal.app, so macOS asks for the **Microphone** and **Screen Recording** for it directly.
  It is listed as "natdal" under System Settings → Privacy & Security; the first time, natdal's
  older entries there are reset so it appears once.
- **Saved-file notifications**: a saved recording's notification names the file, its length and its
  folder. Clicking it shows the file — in Finder on macOS (screenshots too), in File Explorer on
  Windows.
- **clickloop's settings are simpler**: two pages and six controls instead of five pages. Nothing
  the CLI or MCP can do was removed.

## Fixes

- **Windows: inkshot's notifications stay in the notification centre.** A saved recording, a saved
  or copied capture and an agent's notice used to vanish a few seconds after they showed — from the
  notification centre too. Windows now takes the pop-up away after the time set in Windows, and the
  notification stays in the notification centre.
- **macOS: an update also updates inkshot's screen helper.** After an update the old helper could
  keep running; natdal now replaces a helper left from another version when it starts.
- **The update status no longer offers the version just installed.** After an install, `natdal
  update status` and Settings → Updates say natdal is up to date.
- macOS: the menu bar moon is always the white moon. On macOS 26 a see-through menu bar over a tinted
  wallpaper made it a solid black moon among white icons.
- `natdal` followed by a word that is not one of its commands printed nothing and opened the tray
  app; it now prints "unknown command" with the usage and exits with code 2.

## Removed

- **Guildlings** is retired and no longer comes with natdal.
- **tools' AI usage** (the coding-agent usage tracker and its dashboard) is removed. Keep awake, the
  break reminder and always on top stay. Hooks or a status line it added to a coding agent's
  settings are not removed automatically; they do nothing now and can be deleted by hand.

## Install

- **Windows 10/11 (x64):** `natdal_0.2.0_x64-setup.exe`. Not code-signed yet: Windows SmartScreen
  shows a warning — choose **More info → Run anyway**.
- **macOS 11+ (Apple silicon and Intel):** `natdal_0.2.0_universal.dmg`, signed and notarized.
  Recording needs macOS 15 or later.

Each file has a `.sha256` next to it. Already on natdal 0.1.0? Settings → Updates installs 0.2.0.

## Known limits

- Recording is not available on macOS 14 and earlier, or on Linux.
- An area is recorded on the display under its middle.
- Windows builds are not code-signed yet.

Questions and bug reports: support@natdal.app, or Send feedback… in the tray menu.
